policy.rule: Minutes must name dissenters when a motion is not unanimous. Present voting members must vote unless conflicted; a member not indicating a vote is deemed affirmative. policy.limitations: Minutes convention is documentary evidence, not audiovisual confirmation. Nonstandard motions, ambiguous identities/events, missing or partial sources, unresolved opposition and inconsistent membership/tallies are held.
policy.future_policy: Do not infer meetings after enabled_through without refreshing the official bylaw index and checking subsequent amendments or repeal.

13.   NOTICE OF MOTION

      Notice of Motion from Councillor Guiry

      Whereas Rick Hansen Foundation Accessibility CertificationTM (RHFAC) is a national rating system
      that measures and certifies the level of meaningful access of buildings and sites and the Rick
      Hansen Foundation found that 64% of Canadians have a disability or take care of a person with a
      disability.

      And whereas, one of the key findings of a 2020 Cost Comparison Feasibility Study issued by
      HCMA Architecture + Design was that when meeting the National Building Code there was a cost

      increase of 1% to achieve Rick Hansen Foundation Certified Gold which reinforces that
      "accessibility can be achieved with minimal cost impact through commitment to
      thoughtful/universal design".

      Therefore, Langford Council directs staff to consider Rick Hansen Foundation Accessibility
      CertificationTM (RHFAC) when completing the upcoming review of Langford's Design Guidelines
      and through this process consider a possible timeline for adopting RHFAC as a standard for all
      new buildings in Langford.
